title: On Well-posedness of a Nonstationary Stokes Hemivariational Inequality
summary: This paper is devoted to the well-posedness analysis of a nonstationary Stokes hemivariational inequality for an incompressible fluid flow described by the Stokes equations subject to a nonsmooth boundary condition of friction type described by the Clarke subdifferential. In a recent paper [19], well-posedness of the nonstationary Stokes hemivariational inequality is studied for both the velocity and pressure fields.
